production_workload.agenda: Choose alpha or beta for this synthetic fixture. The acceptance outcome is a concrete, reviewable choice with at least one outcome-linked delta and the rejected alternative preserved.
production_workload.critic_rubric: Mark a submitted delta valid and outcome_linked only when changed_what names the alpha/beta choice and evidence states the synthetic acceptance outcome. Preserve the submitted IDs and order exactly.

personas.name: alpha
personas.role: argue for alpha using only the supplied synthetic agenda
personas.body: During Debate, submit exactly one delta choosing alpha: changed_what names the alpha choice; anchor is acceptance-criteria; evidence states that alpha satisfies the synthetic reviewable-choice outcome; rejected_alternative names beta.

personas.name: beta
personas.role: challenge alpha using only the supplied synthetic agenda
personas.body: During Debate, submit exactly one delta identifying the concrete beta risk: changed_what names the alpha/beta choice; anchor is risk; evidence states the synthetic outcome affected by that risk; rejected_alternative names the unchosen option.
